ICS/LABA was prescribed to 55.6 % of COPD patients in general practice and that the rate of prescription was higher in COPD patients also registered with a concur-rent diagnosis of asthma than in those without asthma (P = 0.001).

the prescribing rate of ICS/LABAs in COPD patients in Norwegian primary care was higher in 2009–10 than recommended by GOLD, but was associated with previous exacerbations and cardiovascular disease, and was lower than recommended by GOLD for the patients with COPD and asthma.
